description: Show the hidden metadata in a photo: camera make/model, lens, date taken, exposure, ISO, software, author/copyright, serial numbers, comments, PNG text chunks, and GPS coordinates (where the photo was taken). Lists every metadata block (EXIF, XMP, ICC, IPTC, embedded previews) with its size and flags privacy-sensitive fields. JPEG and PNG fully; WebP/AVIF/HEIC/TIFF EXIF via sharp. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/exif-cleaner/

image.description: The photo: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

name: image_exif_read
title: Read photo metadata (EXIF)
